title: You don't have access to that
body: Ask an admin if you need it.

title: The app is busy
body: Wait for it to finish what it’s doing, then try again.

title: There’s no space for this app
body: Free up some disk space, then try again.

title: A setting isn't right
body: Check the app’s settings and try again.

title: Other apps need this one
body: Uninstall the apps that use it first.

title: The app didn't start in time
body: Check its logs, then try again.

title: The app couldn't be downloaded
body: Check your internet connection and try again.

title: This app doesn't run on this computer
body: It isn't made for this kind of processor.

title: The app couldn't start
body: Port it needs is already in use by another program.

title: This app can't be reinstalled
body: Its saved settings are missing, so reinstalling would reset its passwords. Uninstall it and install it again instead.

title: The app couldn't be restored
body: Neither the new version nor the previous one started. Check the app's logs.

title: The update didn't start
body: hlabs went back to the previous version. Nothing was lost.

title: That took too long
body: Log in again from the start.

title: That didn't match
body: Check your username and password.

title: That password isn't right
body: Check it and try again.

title: Too many tries
body: Wait 15 minutes, then try again.

title: That recovery code didn't work
body: Each code works once. Try another.

title: You're logged out
body: Log in again to carry on.

title: This reset link has expired
body: Ask an admin for a new one.

title: hlabs can't reach its keychain
body: Unlock this computer, then try again.

title: That code didn't work
body: Use the newest code from your authenticator app.

title: The backup destination didn't accept that
body: Check its username and password.

title: That destination is already added
body: Choose a different one.

title: The backup destination is full
body: Free up space there or keep fewer backups.

title: Can't reach the backup destination
body: Check that it’s connected and on.

title: The backup was interrupted
body: Run it again; it carries on where it stopped.

title: An app couldn't get ready for the backup
body: Check its logs, then run the backup again.

title: Another backup is using this destination
body: Wait for it to finish, then try again.

title: That backup password isn't right
body: Use the password from when these backups were made.

title: That didn't go through
body: Reload the page and try again.

title: hlabs is starting
body: This usually takes less than a minute. Try again then.

title: This computer is out of space
body: Free up some disk space, then try again.

title: Pi-hole refused the app password
body: Make an app password in Pi-hole under Settings › Web interface / API, then paste it here.

title: The DNS server isn't answering
body: Check its address and that it is running, then try again.

title: The download stalled
body: Check your internet connection and try again.

title: hlabs can't install an engine here
body: Install Docker yourself, then try again.

title: The engine didn't start
body: Try again, or restart this computer.

title: The container engine isn't running
body: Start it in Settings › Engine & startup.

title: You don't have access to that
body: Ask the person who shared it.

title: That name won't work
body: Names can’t contain / or be empty.

title: That place doesn't exist
body: It may have been moved or removed.

title: Something uses this folder
body: An app would stop finding it if it changed.

title: That name is taken
body: Choose another name.

title: There’s no space left there
body: Free up some space, then try again.

title: Trash doesn't cover this drive
body: Items on network drives are deleted for good instead.

title: This folder is read-only
body: Save it somewhere else.

title: That address is taken
body: Choose another name.

title: Something went wrong
body: Try again. If it keeps happening, check the logs in Settings › Advanced.

title: This invite doesn't work anymore
body: Ask the person who invited you for a new link.

title: hlabs is busy
body: Wait for what it’s doing to finish, then try again.

title: This can't be stopped now
body: It will finish on its own shortly.

title: hlabs needs at least one admin
body: Make someone else an admin first.

title: Your library already has an app called that
body: Choose another name.

title: There is no signing key on this computer
body: Make one with hlabs library keygen, then sign again.

title: The NAS didn't accept that
body: Check the username and password.

title: hlabs can't connect to network drives here
body: Reinstall hlabs to add the missing helper.

title: That share is read-only
body: Choose a share hlabs can write to.

title: Can't reach the NAS
body: Check the address and that the NAS is on.

title: That port is in use
body: Another program is using it. Choose another port or close that program.

title: This isn't here any more
body: It may have been removed or renamed.

title: This isn't ready yet
body: It arrives with a later update of hlabs.

title: hlabs is already set up
body: Log in to carry on.

title: Setup isn't finished
body: Go back and complete the missing step.

title: Open setup from this computer
body: Use the link from the hlabs menu bar app or the install script.

title: That step isn't available yet
body: Finish the steps before it first.

title: An admin already exists
body: Log in with that account.

title: That password is too common
body: Choose one that’s harder to guess.

title: That password is too short
body: Use at least 12 characters.

title: That's your current password
body: Choose a new one.

title: The restore can't be stopped now
body: Stopping it here could damage your data. It will finish soon.

title: That isn't a source address
body: Paste an https:// address, such as https://github.com/you/your-app-store, or a folder path.

title: The built-in store can't be removed
body: It comes with hlabs.

title: No hlabs apps found at this address
body: A source needs apps in hlabs's format, with an index.json made by hlabs library index.

title: This source is already added
body: It's in the list above.

title: Couldn't read this source
body: Its files are too big or point outside it. Ask whoever runs it.

title: Choose a folder in hlabs
body: A library folder has to be inside hlabs's storage, such as your Home folder.

title: Choose a folder only admins can change
body: Others could change apps in Shared or their own Home folder. Use your Home folder instead.

title: Signature doesn't match the saved key
body: Its apps may have been changed by someone else, so hlabs stopped using it. Remove it, and add it again only if you trust the new key.

title: Couldn't reach the repository
body: Check the address and that this computer is online. A private repository can't be added.

title: An app uses this drive
body: Choose another folder for it first.

title: hlabs can't save files there
body: Choose a folder you can write to, or check the drive.

title: HTTPS is off in Tailscale
body: Turn on HTTPS certificates in your Tailscale admin console.

title: Tailscale isn't running
body: Open Tailscale on this computer so hlabs can take its addresses off your tailnet, then try again.

title: Tailscale needs permission first
body: Run sudo tailscale set --operator=hlabs once on this computer, then try again.

title: A port is already served
body: Something else on this computer uses it with Tailscale Serve. Choose another port or stop that first.

title: That code didn't work
body: Use the newest code from your authenticator app.

title: Two-factor login is required
body: Your admin requires it for everyone, so it stays on.

title: Turn on two-factor login first
body: Set it up for your own account before requiring it for everyone.

title: The menu bar app isn't connected
body: Quit it and open it again.

title: Couldn't check for updates
body: Check your internet connection.

title: The update couldn't be downloaded
body: Nothing was changed. Check your internet connection and try again.

title: The update didn't start
body: Make sure the hlabs menu-bar app is running on the computer, then try again.

title: hlabs is up to date
body: There is no newer version to install.

title: This update couldn't be verified
body: It wasn't installed. Try again later.

title: This file is uploading somewhere else
body: Wait for it to finish there, or cancel it there.

title: The upload got out of step
body: Try again; it carries on where it stopped.

title: That username won't work
body: Use lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, starting with a letter.

title: That username is taken
body: Choose another one.

title: Something doesn't look right
body: Check what you entered and try again.
